Fighter: Need an axe? I'm with you.
Point me at something to hit.
Archer: I don't miss. Point me at a target.
Mage: My spells aren't gentle, but they're effective.
I've studied enough. Time to fight.
Cavalier: I rode from the front lines. Where do you need me?
Cleric: I can mend what's broken. Stay close.
The wounded need me. Lead on.
Myrmidon: I fight alone. But I'll fight beside you.
Thief: I go where I please. Right now, I please to go with you.
Locks, traps, pockets - I handle them all.
Mercenary: Coin's good. Cause is better. You've got both.
Pegasus Knight: The skies are mine. Let's see what's ahead.
From above, I've seen what the corruption does.
Knight: I am the shield. You are the sword.
Dancer: A dance can turn the tide. Watch and see.
Morale wins wars. I'm here for that.
Wyvern Rider: My wyvern and I answer to no lord. But for this fight - we'll make an exception.
Hero: I've fought in darker wars than this. What matters is seeing it through.
Another war. Let's end this one.
Falcon Knight: From above, I've seen what the corruption does. No more.
Lance and sky. That's all I need.
Sage: The old magic is failing. Perhaps your seer can show us a better path.
Knowledge is a weapon. I'm well-armed.
Assassin: I don't do speeches. Just tell me who dies.
Sniper: One shot. One kill. That's the only math that matters.
I see the target. That's enough.
Bishop: The light fades, but it hasn't gone. Not yet.
Healing and faith. I bring both.
Chevalier: My lance rides where honor demands. Lead, and I follow.
A knight without a charge is nothing. Give me one.
Sky Lancer: The wind answers to no one. Neither do I.
From up here, I see everything. Point me at the real threat.
Sentinel: I don't move. I don't flinch. Come at me.
They'll break against me like waves on stone.

Edric: Rally to me. We're stronger together.
Kira: I see the line to win. Do you?
Voss: Still standing. That's all that matters.
Sera: I dreamt of this moment. Stay close.
Rowan: My lance is blessed. My aim? That's all me.
Astrid: The sky sees what the ground misses. I'll be your sight.
Cael: I'll hold the line. Don't have too much fun back there.

base.speaker: Sera
base.line: I see a path... fragmented, but there. Stay close, {commander}.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: I watched {lastFoe} cut the last thread. This time I have chosen a different one.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: That path ended in ruin. But the threads reweave... and I still see one that doesn't.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: So many threads walked, {commander}. Even victory frays. The corruption stirs again — so do we.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: We won. I saw it end. Yet the visions pull us back — the wound beneath is not closed.

base.speaker: Edric
base.line: Then we walk it together. Move out.

entries.speaker: Edric
entries.line: Then the banner goes forward. Rally to me — we finish this march together.

entries.speaker: Kira
entries.line: Fragmented is fine. I only need one clean line to the throne.

entries.speaker: Voss
entries.line: Paths, visions... I just keep walking until something breaks. Usually it's them.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: And this time I do not just watch the path. I lead it.

entries.speaker: Rowan
entries.line: A blessed lance and a fresh road. One of us is lucky — let's find out which.

entries.speaker: Astrid
entries.line: I'll read the ground from above. The sky remembers every road we haven't tried.

entries.speaker: Cael
entries.line: Then form up behind me. Whatever waits on that path breaks on my shield first.

base.speaker: Sera
base.line: The frontier is behind us. The emperor's forces know we're coming - I can feel the lieutenant watching.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The frontier is behind us. The emperor's forces know we're coming - I can feel the lieutenant watching.

entries.speaker: Edric
entries.line: Let them watch. They'll learn what this army is made of.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The frontier is behind us. The emperor's forces know we're coming - I can feel the lieutenant watching.

entries.speaker: Kira
entries.line: Good. A watcher means a pattern — and every pattern can be broken.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The frontier is behind us. The emperor's forces know we're coming - I can feel the lieutenant watching.

entries.speaker: Voss
entries.line: Been watched before. Buried the watchers. March on.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The frontier is behind us. The emperor's forces know we're coming - I can feel the lieutenant watching.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: Then let my rival watch closely. I want them to see us coming.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The frontier is behind us. The emperor's forces know we're coming - I can feel the lieutenant watching.

entries.speaker: Rowan
entries.line: An imperial audience? I'll try to make the lance work look effortless.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The frontier is behind us. The emperor's forces know we're coming - I can feel the lieutenant watching.

entries.speaker: Astrid
entries.line: Then we move faster than their reports. The wind favors us.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The frontier is behind us. The emperor's forces know we're coming - I can feel the lieutenant watching.

entries.speaker: Cael
entries.line: Let them come. Walls don't flinch because someone is watching.

base.speaker: Edric
base.line: The sacred ground ahead is corrupted. The ritual is close. And so is the lieutenant.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The sacred ground ahead is corrupted. The ritual is close — and so is the lieutenant.

entries.speaker: Edric
entries.line: Corrupted or not, it's still ground. We can cross it.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The sacred ground ahead is corrupted. The ritual is close — and so is the lieutenant.

entries.speaker: Kira
entries.line: A ritual has steps. Steps have an order. We break the order.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The sacred ground ahead is corrupted. The ritual is close — and so is the lieutenant.

entries.speaker: Voss
entries.line: Corruption, rituals... it all bleeds the same.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The sacred ground ahead is corrupted. The ritual is close — and so is the lieutenant.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: My rival presses at the edge of my sight. I will not blink first.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The sacred ground ahead is corrupted. The ritual is close — and so is the lieutenant.

entries.speaker: Rowan
entries.line: Sacred ground should mind a blessed lance. Stay behind me.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The sacred ground ahead is corrupted. The ritual is close — and so is the lieutenant.

entries.speaker: Astrid
entries.line: Even the wind turns away from that place. We won't.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The sacred ground ahead is corrupted. The ritual is close — and so is the lieutenant.

entries.speaker: Cael
entries.line: Then the line holds twice as hard from here on.

base.speaker: Sera
base.line: The lieutenant is near. I can feel their visions pressing against mine. This ends now.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant is near. I can feel their visions pressing against mine. This ends now.

entries.speaker: Edric
entries.line: Whatever they've seen, they haven't seen us at full strength. Forward.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant is near. I can feel their visions pressing against mine. This ends now.

entries.speaker: Kira
entries.line: They've seen every path? Then we make a new one.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant is near. I can feel their visions pressing against mine. This ends now.

entries.speaker: Voss
entries.line: Seen my death a hundred ways, I'd wager. Not one of them stuck.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant is near. Their visions press against mine — but I am done being watched.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: Every future they see, I will unsee. We finish this together.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant is near. I can feel their visions pressing against mine. This ends now.

entries.speaker: Rowan
entries.line: Fate against fate. My lance likes those odds.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant is near. I can feel their visions pressing against mine. This ends now.

entries.speaker: Astrid
entries.line: No vision outruns a dive from the sun. Let's end it.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant is near. I can feel their visions pressing against mine. This ends now.

entries.speaker: Cael
entries.line: Then we knock. Shields first.

act3_to_act4.speaker: Sera
act3_to_act4.line: The lieutenant is gone, but the corruption hasn't stopped. It's stronger. The ritual - the emperor must have completed it before we-

act4_to_finalBoss.speaker: Edric
act4_to_finalBoss.line: The emperor's stronghold. He thinks he can control what he's awakened. He's wrong.

finalBoss_to_secretAct.speaker: Sera
finalBoss_to_secretAct.line: Wait - the ground is shaking. The ritual fed it too much. It's waking up. We have to go down there. Now.

secretAct_start.speaker: Sera
secretAct_start.line: This place is... wrong. The air doesn't move. Time doesn't pass. It's here.

base.speaker: Iron Captain
base.line: You'll go no further. This border belongs to the empire now.

entries.speaker: Iron Captain
entries.line: Back again? Something in my bones says I've broken you once already.

entries.speaker: Iron Captain
entries.line: You... I know your face. From a dream where I died. Not this time.

base.speaker: Iron Captain
base.line: Half my guard, gone... Hold the border! Fall back and REFORM!

base.speaker: Iron Captain
base.line: Impossible... the border was supposed to hold...

entries.speaker: Iron Captain
entries.line: Again... why does it feel like... again...

base.speaker: Warchief
base.line: Another band of fools. My axe grows thirsty.

entries.speaker: Warchief
entries.line: Hah! My axe remembers your blood. Come — let it drink twice!

entries.speaker: Warchief
entries.line: You! I dreamed an army of fools cut me down. Dreams lie. Axes don't.

base.speaker: Warchief
base.line: HAH! Now the blood flows! MORE! GIVE ME MORE!

base.speaker: Warchief
base.line: Hah... you fight well. Better than I expected.

entries.speaker: Warchief
entries.line: Twice... felled twice by the same blade... what a war this is...

base.speaker: Knight Commander
base.line: The emperor's will is absolute. Your little rebellion ends here.

entries.speaker: Knight Commander
entries.line: The emperor's justice found you once. It is patient enough to find you twice.

entries.speaker: Knight Commander
entries.line: I have died for the emperor in my nightmares. You were there. It changes nothing.

base.speaker: Knight Commander
base.line: My armor cracks... but my faith holds. The emperor is watching!

base.speaker: Knight Commander
base.line: The emperor will hear of this. You've only delayed the inevitable.

entries.speaker: Knight Commander
entries.line: Again the rebellion... again this ending... my faith does not waver...

base.speaker: Archmage
base.line: I've studied the rifts your prophet creates. Fascinating - and so fragile.

entries.speaker: Archmage
entries.line: Fascinating — the same variables return. Last iteration, you perished. Shall we replicate?

entries.speaker: Archmage
entries.line: So the rifts do loop. I kept notes on your last visit... and on how you die in this one.

base.speaker: Archmage
base.line: Half integrity lost... recalculating. You are outpacing my models.

base.speaker: Archmage
base.line: The rifts... they're stronger than my models predicted...

entries.speaker: Archmage
entries.line: Reproducible... my death is... reproducible... what a final datum...

base.speaker: Blade Lord
base.line: The lieutenant sees all paths. You walk the one that ends in your grave.

entries.speaker: Blade Lord
entries.line: The lieutenant showed me this thread. It ends the same way: on my blade.

entries.speaker: Blade Lord
entries.line: The lieutenant warned me the sealed path had been walked before. So it's you.

base.speaker: Blade Lord
base.line: Bleeding... the lieutenant never showed me this thread. No matter. I cut my own.

base.speaker: Blade Lord
base.line: You shouldn't be here. The lieutenant said this path was sealed.

entries.speaker: Blade Lord
entries.line: Cut down... in thread after thread... master, I'm sorry...

base.speaker: Iron Wall
base.line: None have breached these walls. None ever will.

entries.speaker: Iron Wall
entries.line: These walls broke you once. Stones remember. So do I.

entries.speaker: Iron Wall
entries.line: I have felt these walls fall before — in a dream that tasted of your steel.

base.speaker: Iron Wall
base.line: The walls crack... then I am the wall. Come and break against ME.

base.speaker: Iron Wall
base.line: The walls... are nothing... without the will behind them...

entries.speaker: Iron Wall
entries.line: The walls fall... as they always fall... to you...

base.speaker: The Lieutenant
base.line: I've seen every future you could reach. In all of them, you fall.

entries.speaker: The Lieutenant
entries.line: You return. Of course you return. I have ended you before — this timeline makes one more.

entries.speaker: The Lieutenant
entries.line: So it was never one path I failed to seal, but a weave of them. Impressive. Futile — but impressive.

base.speaker: The Lieutenant
base.line: You cut deeper than the visions promised. Enough. I stop holding back the future.

entries.speaker: Edric
entries.line: Then look again. This army writes its own future.

entries.speaker: Kira
entries.line: Every future? Then you already know the move I haven't made yet. Liar.

entries.speaker: Voss
entries.line: Seen me fall, have you? Watch me get up. It's what I do.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: Your sight ends where mine begins. Shall we compare visions?

entries.speaker: Rowan
entries.line: Fate's a coin toss, friend. My lance calls heads.

entries.speaker: Astrid
entries.line: You've never seen a future from as high as I have.

entries.speaker: Cael
entries.line: Then you've seen my shield too. Tell me — did you find a way through it?

base.speaker: The Lieutenant
base.line: You... found the one path I couldn't block. But it won't matter. My master's work is already done.

entries.speaker: The Lieutenant
entries.line: Every timeline... you find me in every one... master, the pattern... is breaking...

base.speaker: The Emperor
base.line: You think you've won something by killing my seer? I don't need visions. I have power.

entries.speaker: The Emperor
entries.line: The ritual showed me your corpse, rebel. I have already outlived you once.

entries.speaker: The Emperor
entries.line: You. The regicide echoes through the rift — I have felt this death before. Never again.

base.speaker: The Emperor
base.line: You DARE wound me? I held the dark back for decades — behold what I kept for myself!

entries.speaker: Edric
entries.line: Power stolen from a sleeping god. We're here to return it.

entries.speaker: Kira
entries.line: Power without sight is just a bigger target.

entries.speaker: Voss
entries.line: Power, huh. Had that once. Outlived it.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: Your seer is gone, emperor. I am the only one left who knows how this ends.

entries.speaker: Rowan
entries.line: Blessings beat borrowed power. Care to test it?

entries.speaker: Astrid
entries.line: All that power, and you still never saw us coming.

entries.speaker: Cael
entries.line: Then throw it at me first. I insist.

base.speaker: The Emperor
base.line: You fools. You have no idea what I was holding back. Without me, there's nothing between you and-

entries.speaker: The Emperor
entries.line: Not... again... the rift takes everything I was... every time...

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: It stirs before we move. It remembers... unmaking us.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: It knows we've hurt it before. The air itself is afraid. So is it.

base.line: The stillness shudders. Something vast turns its attention fully upon you.

entries.speaker: Edric
entries.line: It doesn't speak. It doesn't need to. Steel yourselves — we end the cycle here.

entries.speaker: Kira
entries.line: No taunts. No tells. Finally, an honest opponent.

entries.speaker: Voss
entries.line: Quiet one, eh. Good. I'm done listening.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: I hear it. Beneath the silence — every timeline screaming at once. Fight on.

entries.speaker: Rowan
entries.line: Not much for conversation? My lance speaks fluent silence.

entries.speaker: Astrid
entries.line: The air itself won't carry me near it... then we walk. Together.

entries.speaker: Cael
entries.line: It can stare all it wants. The wall doesn't blink.

base.speaker: Sera
base.line: It's... receding. Going back to sleep. We did it. It's over.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: Back to sleep... again. One day the cycle ends. Perhaps this day was it.

base.speaker: Dark Rider
base.line: The shadows ride with me. You cannot outrun the dark.

entries.speaker: Dark Rider
entries.line: The shadows still carry your scent. They led me to you once. They will feast twice.

entries.speaker: Dark Rider
entries.line: The dark whispered that a rider falls at this crossroads. I thought it meant another.

base.speaker: Dark Rider
base.line: My blood on the wind... the shadows howl for yours in kind.

base.speaker: Dark Rider
base.line: The darkness... will find another rider...

entries.speaker: Dark Rider
entries.line: Always this crossroads... always your blade... the dark... lied to me...

base.speaker: Berserker King
base.line: Blood and iron! I'll crush you with my bare hands if I have to!

entries.speaker: Berserker King
entries.line: YOU! My blood sang of this! The one I crushed comes crawling back for more!

entries.speaker: Berserker King
entries.line: I know you! The worthy death from my dreams! COME! Give it to me again!

base.speaker: Berserker King
base.line: YES! Half dead and twice alive! THIS is a fight worth my crown!

base.speaker: Berserker King
base.line: Hah... finally... a fight worth dying for...

entries.speaker: Berserker King
entries.line: Again... hah... HAH... what a gift... to die this well... twice...

base.speaker: Sera
base.line: The lieutenant has fallen. The visions are clearing... but something deeper still stirs. I can feel it.

entries.speaker: Edric
entries.line: It's done. The lieutenant has fallen — the army can finally breathe.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: For the first time since the visions began... I see an unwritten page. Thank you, {commander}.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: But something deeper still stirs beneath it all. If it wakes... we will be needed again.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant has fallen. The visions are clearing... but something deeper still stirs.

entries.speaker: Edric
entries.line: Clear skies are enough for today. Tomorrow we ready the banner again.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant has fallen. The visions are clearing... but something deeper still stirs.

entries.speaker: Kira
entries.line: Something deeper... so the real game has more moves left. Good. I hate endings.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant has fallen. The visions are clearing... but something deeper still stirs.

entries.speaker: Voss
entries.line: Still stirring, is it? Fine. I'm still standing.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant has fallen. My rival's visions have gone quiet... but something deeper stirs.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: Then I will keep watch over the deep. It's my turn to guard the dream.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant has fallen. The visions are clearing... but something deeper still stirs.

entries.speaker: Rowan
entries.line: Let it stir. The lance stays blessed, and my aim is only getting better.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant has fallen. The visions are clearing... but something deeper still stirs.

entries.speaker: Astrid
entries.line: Then I'll fly higher next time — and see it coming before it wakes.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The lieutenant has fallen. The visions are clearing... but something deeper still stirs.

entries.speaker: Cael
entries.line: Let it come when it comes. It'll find the wall already built.

victory_hard.speaker: Sera
victory_hard.line: The emperor is defeated. The ritual is broken... mostly. I still see something beneath it all. Sleeping, but not for long.

victory_lunatic.speaker: Sera
victory_lunatic.line: It's going back to sleep. The cycle is broken. For the first time... I can't see what comes next. And that's beautiful.

base.speaker: Sera
base.line: No... this path leads to ruin. We must try again.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: No... this path leads to ruin. We must try again.

entries.speaker: Edric
entries.line: Then we try again. As many times as it takes — the banner doesn't stay down.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: No... this path leads to ruin. We must try again.

entries.speaker: Kira
entries.line: A losing line. Noted, learned, discarded. Deal the board again.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: No... this path leads to ruin. We must try again.

entries.speaker: Voss
entries.line: Ruin, then. Wouldn't be my first. Wake me when we march.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: No... this path leads to ruin. I led us into the dark, and the dark led.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: The threads reweave. Next time, I choose better.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: No... this path leads to ruin. We must try again.

entries.speaker: Rowan
entries.line: Even blessed steel misses. Next time, fate pays what it owes.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: No... this path leads to ruin. We must try again.

entries.speaker: Astrid
entries.line: The ground took us this time. The sky and I will remember the way back.

entries.speaker: Sera
entries.line: No... this path leads to ruin. We must try again.

entries.speaker: Cael
entries.line: The wall cracked. Walls get rebuilt. Thicker.

act1: The air tastes of iron here.
Scouts spotted movement ahead.
Something stirs beyond the treeline.
The ground is scarred from old battles.
The quarry roads are empty. The levies took even the picks to war.
Half the blades dug from this ground still carry Varen's mark.
act2: Imperial banners hang in tatters.
The corruption has touched this place.
Smoke rises from the far ridge.
Old fortifications, hastily rebuilt.
The old kingdom's roads run straight and true. The tolls are the empire's.
This province feeds the war economy a cartload at a time.
act3: The sky darkens without clouds.
Reality bends at the edges here.
The earth hums with a low, wrong note.
Even the wind sounds uncertain.
The fens drain from the sacred ground. They always have.
The seers' liturgy names this place. The last pages are about it.
act4: The air itself resists each step.
Shadows move against the light.
This land remembers what was done to it.
The corruption runs deep here. Deeper than roots.
The court circle's seals are on every door.
These walls were raised to keep something in.
finalBoss: The end of the path. One way or another.
Everything converges here.
No more detours. No more preparation.
The world holds its breath.
Every timeline the seers have walked passes through this floor.

act1: A stronger presence guards this road.
The scouts fell back. That's never good.
Something here doesn't want to be found.
The usual patrols don't come this way.
act2: An officer commands these troops. Stay sharp.
Imperial elites. Not conscripts — true believers.
This garrison was reinforced recently.
They knew we were coming.
act3: The corruption has champions of its own.
Power radiates from this place. Twisted power.
Whatever guards this place has forgotten mercy.
The air crackles. Not lightning — something older.
act4: A fragment of the emperor's will, given form.
This one was shaped by the ritual itself.
The corruption's finest soldier stands ready.
Even the ground trembles at what waits ahead.
finalBoss: The last guardian. The strongest.
All that power, concentrated in one vessel.
This is the price of the final step.
It knows why we've come.

act1: A commander holds the line ahead.
The border's strongest awaits.
Steel and discipline guard this crossing.
Their leader won't yield ground easily.
act2: The lieutenant's chosen blocks our path.
An imperial champion. Forged in conquest.
This one answers directly to the throne.
Command tents and war banners. A true siege.
act3: The ritual's guardian manifests.
Something ancient defends this ground.
The corruption's vessel awaits us.
Something presses against the edge of perception.
act4: The emperor's inner circle. The last wall.
Power like this shouldn't exist in mortal hands.
This is what the ritual was building toward.
Beyond this, only the emperor himself.
finalBoss: The source of everything. Right here.
All roads led to this moment.
No visions needed to see what comes next.
The world's fate rests on what happens here.

act1: Someone signals from the roadside.
A survivor. Still willing to fight.
Not everyone has given up on this land.
Another blade for the cause.
act2: A deserter from the imperial ranks.
They've seen what the empire really is.
Courage finds strange vessels sometimes.
One more soul choosing the harder path.
act3: Even here, someone still resists.
The corruption hasn't claimed everyone.
A fighter, hardened by what they've survived.
They don't need convincing. They need a direction.
act4: Survival alone takes strength here.
To still fight, this deep in — that's something.
The corruption spat this one out. Their loss.
Another who refused to break.
finalBoss: Even at the end, allies find us.
One last warrior, drawn to the final stand.
They know the odds. They came anyway.
Some debts can only be paid in battle.

Edric: The banner is yours now. Keep them together.
This is as far as I march. Carry it the rest of the way, {commander}.
Don't look back. The army follows you now.
Kira: I found the winning line... just not for me.
Don't stop. The path is still there. I can almost see it.
Heh. Thought I'd be the last one standing.
Voss: Still standing... for now. Go. Finish this.
Took more than I expected. Don't waste what's left.
The shield breaks so the sword can strike. Go.
Sera: The visions are fading... but I see you, {commander}. You'll find the way.
I couldn't see this path. Maybe that means it's the right one.
The future isn't written yet. Not even I could see this far.
Rowan: My lance... it's blessed. Take it. It'll know your hand.
The sky was beautiful from up there. Keep looking up.
One last charge. Make it count for both of us.
Astrid: I could see so far from up there... not far enough, it seems.
The wind carries on. So should you.
Don't look down. I never did.
Cael: The line holds. Even without me, the line holds.
I said I'd hold. And I did. Now go.
Every wall falls eventually. Build a better one.

act1: The light returns to their eyes, slowly.
A second chance. Don't waste it.
Breath returns. The wound remembers.
act2: The altar's power runs deeper than faith.
Pulled back from the edge. Not gently.
The old prayers still carry weight here.
act3: Even the light struggles against what's coming.
Revival feels different now. Heavier.
The corruption makes the healing harder.
act4: The altar burns brighter, as if in defiance.
Brought back in spite of everything.
Light and dark, balanced on a knife's edge.
finalBoss: One more miracle. Perhaps the last.
The light knows what's at stake.
Restoration, at the world's end.

act1: Growth, earned in blood and resolve.
The change is visible. Sharper. Stronger.
A new chapter begins.
act2: Power awakens where there was only potential.
